title: VocalBench Demo
subtitle: This page presents controlled comparative results for a single source utterance under diverse active defense methods, channel perturbation conditions, and voice cloning model settings. The interface is released as a static artifact to support reproducible web presentation.

sample.transcript: The reality is that the richest people on the planet do not pay their fair share in taxes attacks on the wealth of the 3000 richest people in the world of about 3% a year would raise $400 billion. A slight increase in the minimum tax of on multinational popul…
sample.note: This waveform is the shared source sample; all defense, variant, and model outputs are compared against it.

paper_points: VocalGen collects authentic social-media speech and builds channel variants.
VocalBench applies active defenses to the same source utterance.
VocalEval sends each defended sample into both TTS and VC cloning models.
meta.overview: Start with the shared source sample, then compare defended reference speech across defense branches. Each variant applies an additional channel perturbation to the defended speech; expanding a variant reveals TTS and VC model outputs under the same condition.
reading_steps: Source Audio is the shared reference sample used for cross-branch comparison.
Defense nodes correspond to defended reference speech produced by active defense methods.
Variant pills indicate additional channel transformations applied to each defended reference.
The VC branch reports outputs from GPTSoVITS_VC and SeedVC.

meta.sample_note: For controlled comparison, all TTS/VC outputs use the same short prompt text; VC models use branch-specific defended speech as target-speaker references.

branches.note: No active defense is applied; this branch serves as the baseline condition.
